description: Defines structures and classes related to Signed Certificate Timestamps (SCTs) for Certificate Transparency, including data structures for SignedEntryData, DigitallySigned, and SignedCertificateTimestamp, with associated enums and methods.

classes.name: SignedEntryData
classes.description: Represents data necessary to reconstruct a signed entry for a SignedCertificateTimestamp, including type, leaf certificate, issuer key hash, and TBS certificate.

classes.name: DigitallySigned
classes.description: Represents a digitally signed structure with hash and signature algorithms and signature data.

classes.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp
classes.description: Represents an SCT with version, log ID, timestamp, extensions, signature, origin, and log description, with methods for persistence and creation from pickle.

classes.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp::LessThan
classes.description: Predicate functor for comparing SCTs, used as a key in maps.

methods.name: SignedEntryData::Reset
methods.description: Resets the SignedEntryData to default state.

methods.name: DigitallySigned::SignatureParametersMatch
methods.description: Checks if the hash and signature algorithms match given other algorithms.

methods.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp::Persist
methods.description: Serializes the SCT into a pickle.

methods.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp::CreateFromPickle
methods.description: Creates an SCT instance from a pickle iterator.
